kevinXuPrinciples: All in on one stock at a time
Shares only — no options, no crypto, no margin (nothing that can go to zero overnight)
Terminally online: follow where retail attention is going (vibes), not DCF
Buy at support with a real near-term catalyst — for new all-in that catalyst is a verified earnings date exactly 7 calendar days out
Never chase a stock that has already run
Sell before the rumor becomes fully priced news; +20–30% / screenshot rule
No stop-losses — watch like a hawk
Retail darlings / meme names are in-universe if early (support+catalyst), out if already ran
Ackman quality checklist is research, not a second simultaneous book
